evidence: development: archived dev streams of research/jit-20261008/runs (dev split, seeds 201-248). H is held out from every choice this item makes (tiers, rules, order, thresholds); it is NOT sealed and NOT a fresh draw.
units: an archived compiled answer (one arm's run of one task, solver version in force) whose $0 replay is faithful (leverage.mjs fidelity gate: 88 of 88)

split.rule: H iff parseInt(sha256('tierdown-20261021/split\0' + taskKey)[0], 16) >= 8, else C (experiments/tierdown/tier-replay.mjs sliceOf); every arm's run of a task is in the same slice

screen.classesFrom: C rows only (experiments/tierdown/classes.mjs); low < 0.05 <= mid < 0.20 <= high; unmeasured = high

tiers.claude-haiku-5-5: policy/models.json models[] (class M), via ModelPort, decoding {reasoning: none}, one answer per decision (K = 1)
tiers.mercury-3: policy/models.json executorModels[], ModelPort by explicit id (portModelById), strict json_schema, run token cap
tiers.rule: experiments/tierdown/rules/index.mjs, written by the frontier author from C requests only, abstains on anything it does not recognise; frozen by sha256 in the amendment before any H call
tiers.memo: an identical delivery request (system, prompt, schema) from another arm's run in the archive answers at $0; otherwise abstains
tiers.jev-1.13.0: listed for enum leaves, REFUSED in this session: FOUNDRY_SYSTEMONE_API_KEY is not provisioned (recorded as a blocker, not a result)

agreement: tolerant decision-leaf agreement with the archived reference answer (tierdown.mjs decisionAgreement, compare.mjs tolerance relTol 0.01; evidence keys stripped); exact = identical decision leaves
injection: experiments/tierdown/inject.mjs: tier answers served end to end through the override, every other judge at its archived answer (strict memo); missing, invalid or abstained answers and answers the solver's own check rejects fall back to the reference (cascade [tier, reference]) and are charged both; deopt/crash charged the arm's mean interpreter cost; unmeasured (replay miss) excluded and reported

selection.perSite: on C: the cheapest tier (rule = memo = mercury-3 < claude-haiku-5-5 by listed price; ties by higher mean agreement) that passes Bound 2 on C and has zero pass->fail injected flips on C
selection.order: sites with a selected tier, in descending C-slice judge saving per unit (reference USD - tier USD incl. fallbacks); computed mechanically from C results and frozen (with the rules sha256) in AMENDMENT-1 before any H call

promotion.bound1: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the H pass->fail flip rate over the site's H units <= delta(class) (0 flips need 29 / 59 / 149 units)
promotion.bound2: mean decision-leaf disagreement on H <= 0.05, and usable-answer rate >= 0.95 (a rule tier: >= 1 usable answer, abstentions fall back)
promotion.testing: fixed sequence in the frozen order at alpha 0.05 each; stop at the first site that fails
promotion.prediction: Bound 1 cannot hold for any site here: the largest per-site H unit count in the archive is 16 (records/country-names) < 29. The primary policy is therefore expected to equal the reference everywhere (cost saved 0); the item reports how many units each site would need.

secondary.label: exploratory, NOT a promotion: provisional tier-down
secondary.rule: a selected (site, tier) is kept provisionally on H when it has zero pass->fail flips on its H units and passes Bound 2 on H; the combined provisional policy is injected on all H units at once

equalAccuracy: paired H units, policy vs all-reference: exact McNemar (two-sided p) and non-inferiority at a 3-point margin (one-sided 95% CP upper bound on the loss rate minus the observed gain rate < 0.03); flips in both directions reported
capability: cost saved at equal accuracy = 1 - C_policy / C_ref, judge USD per unit at delivery time on H (archived list-price costs for reference answers, measured costs for tier answers, k-sample votes charged k times for a model tier), plus p50/p95 judge latency; build-time (compile + check) spend reported separately

baselines.B-ref: every site at its reference answer (the solvers as compiled)
baselines.B-screen: the existing tierdown.mjs rule without leverage: per site the cheapest tier whose C mean leaf agreement >= 0.98
baselines.B-all-haiku: every site that has Haiku answers at Haiku
baselines.B-all-mercury: every site that has Mercury answers at Mercury
baselines.B-sink: frontier/reference kept on the global readers (records/rules, records/source-rules, kinetics/well-events, kinetics/prose-events-a), cheapest measured tier everywhere else

faults: environment faults (rate or session limit, timeout, unavailable, token cap) are never answers and never scored; 5 consecutive faults stop the run (exit 75), the driver waits 30 minutes and resumes from the answers file
